project_name: CNN-Based Single-Object Detection on Synthetic MNIST Canvases
dataset: Synthetic 64x64 canvases generated from MNIST digits
outputs: one normalized bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2]
nms_reason: The model predicts exactly one object and one bounding box per image.
limitations: Designed for one handwritten digit on a dark 64x64 canvas.
Not a general-purpose detector for photographs or multiple objects.
Bounding-box localization performance is modest and should be interpreted cautiously.
responsible_use: Educational and portfolio demonstration only. Do not use as the sole basis for surveillance, safety-critical monitoring, autonomous driving, medical, security, legal, or production inspection decisions.
